source.ref: Karnataka Stamp Act, 1957, Sch. Art. 47 (subst. by Act 16 of 2015 w.e.f. 1-4-2015)
source.quoted_text: Sch Art. 47 (both columns): 'Security bond or mortgage-deed, executed by way of security for the due execution of an office, or to account for money or other property received by virtue thereof, or execution by a surety to secure the due performance of a contract — (a) when the amount secured does not exceed rupees one thousand — Fifty paise for every rupees one hundred or part thereof [0.5%]; (b) in any other case — Rupees two hundred.'
